name: Yamawaki Tae
source:
Occupation: Farmer
Stay as: Dweller

A resident of the village of Fujiyoshi who works in the fields. Tae is superstitious, and not always friendly towards newcomers.

She lives in a house located near the rice fields.

[Taken from the official art book included with the [url=/r65525]Day One Edition[/url].]
